featured_reviews.name: Michelle Yang
featured_reviews.review_text:
Started the course on 6th April 26, and just passed my driving test 25th May 26. Everything from start to finish was efficiently managed. You just need to walk in with ur aadhar card number and mobile to register. They will take the picture, they will make the LL. Brownie point they ve standby cars ready incase the AC broke down or a previous student damaged the car. Class always started on time and on the one instance it started late the teacher recovered it for me. I had Mohsin Sir, he’s a kind and knowledgeable teacher… all my queries were explained and feedback given at the end of class.. After 10 regular lessons I upgraded to Pro as I wanted to drive further away from Town ( 10 classes x1 hr and 2 classes x1.30hrd) it was a pleasant decision coz the routes are pre planned and included roads like the sea link and freeway.
Due to a lot of factors including RTo delays I had to  ask them twice to apply for early exam date which was only open for June … but lo and behold they called me once to ask if I could take some other applicants early spot who wished to delay..
Anyways cherry on top they have overall good management system, exam day was reminded with WhatsApp..  I had lost my MVWG LL license and realised on a Sunday the day before ..🫣… bless the team they replied at 8 in the morning of the exam and send me a pdf which I printed outside at RTO… even the exam process was smooth.. they have a team there with a car ready… I just went there got into the car took a round of the ground answered a few questions and within 25 mins was out of the RTo with My receipt.
This is my first driving license in India, I m happy with their service.. apparently while I was waiting at the centre for my class  I learnt they help with all sorts of RTO work… and they advised me for my sisters and mums license renewal ☺️
Wrote so much because I want to say genuine Thanks to Your Team, 🤞 Good Luck

featured_reviews.review_text:

They have off on Thursdays. So no class.

The Theory lectures are conducted on alternate Sundays - 10-12 AM.

I took training for Ertiga, from Rakesh Master and is very professional, patient, a good teacher.

Learners license :
1. There is RTO exam application to practice questions with time option, so before going for exam you want to practice the questions.
2. In case you fail, you may re-appear for the test again one week after that date.
3. RTO charges 100 as fine for reappearing learners test.
4. There are 15 questions out of which 9 is passing.

Overall it has been a very good experience at Excellent Driving School. Very well trained Teachers / Driving masters. Responsive staff.  I have personally extended my period of class to get good hands on experience before driving test.
